about: Small, local, private tools for underrated problems, and a factory to make many more. Python 3.9+ standard library only: no installs, no accounts, and no data leaves your Mac (except heat_risk city mode, which calls the free Open-Meteo forecast).

quickstart.heading: Use the tools
quickstart.code:
cd toolsmith
python3 toolbox.py list
python3 toolbox.py demo scam_check
python3 toolbox.py run subscription_leaks ~/Downloads/bank.csv
python3 toolbox.py serve

steps.title: Pick an idea
steps.body: python3 toolbox.py ideas shows a scored backlog of underrated problems.

steps.title: Scaffold it
steps.body: toolbox.py new creates a new tool from the template.

steps.title: Test everything
steps.body: toolbox.py test runs every tool's self-test.
